AG01.title: Activation scope
AG01.required_result: Exact approved Schema V2 may become eligible for version-dispatched canonical validation only after a later reviewed activation decision.

AG02.title: Decision 0019 successor
AG02.required_result: Decision 0019 remains immutable; a new successor decision must introduce V1/V2 dispatch.

AG03.title: Schema V2 hash contract
AG03.required_result: V2 receives a separately versioned hash/canonicalization contract explicitly bound to the exact approved V2 schema.

AG04.title: Frozen V1 non-migration
AG04.required_result: zlib and libpcap remain byte-identical and Git-blob-identical.

AG05.title: Version dispatch and coexistence
AG05.required_result: schema_version 1.0.0 dispatches to V1; schema_version 2.0.0 dispatches to V2 only after activation; unknown versions reject.

AG06.title: Mapping separation
AG06.required_result: Schema activation does not define or authorize positive V4-to-V2 mapping.

AG07.title: No curl materialization
AG07.required_result: No curl.json is created by this package or by activation governance review.

AG08.title: No downstream execution authorization
AG08.required_result: No analyzer, baseline, or repair authorization follows from this package.

AG09.title: Independent review before activation
AG09.required_result: All AG01-AG09 must pass independent human review before a later activation decision.
